source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE items 4/5 and abstract: effect of liquid nitrogen storage vs fresh lysis on four AML patients. MaxQuant FreshFrozen_SS summary.txt groups HR82_FRESH with Exp_1A and HR82_FROZEN with Exp_1B (17 -> Exp_2A/B, 23 -> Exp_3A/B, FIL -> Exp_4A/B), so suffix A = fresh, B = frozen, and HR82/17/23/FIL = patients 1-4. Independent data checks on deposited peptides.txt (fresh range-read from Search_FreshFrozen-LF.zip / Search_FreshFrozen_SS.zip; summary.txt byte-identical to cached copy): (a) patient identity: patient-centred log2 peptide profiles (7843 peptides) correlate block-diagonally between LF experiments n-A/n-B and SS light Exp_nA/nB (same-patient r = 0.28-0.74, other-patient r <= 0.19), so LF patient n = SS patient n for all four; Y-chromosome peptides appear only for patient 4 in both sets; (b) A/B orientation: per-patient (A - B) difference vectors correlate positively between LF and SS for all 16 patient pairs (diagonal 0.10-0.20, none negative), so LF -A has the same orientation as SS A (= FRESH). Cleavage: partial (first 20 MB compressed) range-read of each FreshFrozen evidence.txt covering all raw files: every LF, SS-proteome and phospho run shows a single-trypsin pattern (K-terminal 48-65%, R-terminal 34-49%, no Lys-C-eluate signature), consistent with Trypsin only and PRIDE 'FASP single digested'. MaxQuant FreshFrozen-LF summary.txt experiments 1-A..4-B and QC1-3, Enzyme Trypsin, MBR True.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE /files (168 entries, every projectAccessions == PXD003822): 163 RAW + 5 SEARCH zips. Across the six sibling SDRFs all 163 RAW files are claimed exactly once (no duplicates, no unclaimed, no names absent from PRIDE). 11 SDRF data files = 11 MaxQuant FreshFrozen-LF raw files = PRIDE item 4 ('four fresh/frozen pairs and 3 quality controls').

design_consistency.evidence: 4 patients x {freshly lysed, liquid nitrogen storage}: biological replicate = patient number 1-4 within each storage group (spec: numbering restarts per factor-value group), fresh and frozen of a patient share characteristics[individual] FF_patient_n. QC pool (PRIDE: 'a mix of all samples') = 3 technical replicates of one pooled source, biological replicate/individual/pooled sample = pooled. Patient IDs consistent with sibling freshfrozen-silac/phospho SDRFs and supported by data (see source_evidence).

omission_safety.evidence: Organism part, cell type, age, sex = not available: PRIDE record and abstract give no per-patient tissue/demographic data (abstract: 'cell lysates from patients with AML'); ancestry/developmental stage omitted rather than guessed; no precursor tolerance invented; disease AML (MONDO:0018874) stated by title/abstract; instrument/CID/35 NCE/ion-trap MS2 confirmed in RAW headers (method text 'Orbitrap Elite MS', 'Activation Type: CID', 'Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0', ITMS MS/MS); fragment tolerance 0.6 Da = parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (ITMS) 0.6 Da'; fixed Carbamidomethyl (C), variable Acetyl (Protein N-term)/Oxidation (M) from parameters/summary. Sex left not available even though Y-peptides suggest patient 4 is male; inferring sex from proteomic data would exceed the stated evidence.
